verdict.rationale: Statsig documents one product-owned scheduling capability: setting up a Feature Gate as a Scheduled Rollout, which deploys a feature gradually over time on a schedule. That is a narrow, rollout-specific workflow rather than general recurring jobs. The CLI-in-CI/CD mention is a user-side workaround and earns no credit. missing for 10: general-purpose recurring job or workflow scheduling, cron-like recurrence, scheduled tasks beyond feature rollouts (e.g. scheduled reports or analyses), API/MCP control of schedules for AI-native users, independent corroboration.
